composition: The horizontal-accordion verb (§21). Six panels share one row; the active one opens to a full photo with the family's final services as links into their own portfolio views, the others collapse to a numbered vertical label. On a phone it turns ninety degrees: panels stack and the collapsed label runs across, it never becomes a plain list (§14).
